title: PaisaPulse Ledger
description: An Android personal finance app that detects banking transactions from SMS, categorizes expenses using an AI-powered FastAPI service, and helps users manage budgets, track spending, and export transaction data. Built and released independently on Google Play, with background processing and duplicate prevention.

title: DevPulse AI ⚡
description: Offline-first developer debugging companion: sends stack traces and snippets to Gemini for concise actionable diagnostics, with Room-backed history and fast local search. Built with MVVM, clean architecture and Hilt.

title: StudyMate AI
description: A study companion for AI tutoring, quizzes, flashcards and planning, with local progress tracking. GPT-5.6 integration is designed through a secure server gateway; live AI requires backend configuration.

title: PostExplorer
description: A Kotlin and Jetpack Compose practice app exploring REST API integration with JSONPlaceholder, Retrofit, asynchronous loading and a clean list-based interface.

title: WhatsappMEGA
description: A WhatsApp-inspired Android onboarding and authentication flow with splash screen, welcome screen, phone-number OTP sign-in, Firebase Authentication, Hilt and MVVM.
